mcp_tools.name: agent_safety_guardrail_audit
mcp_tools.title: Agent safety guardrail audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit an agent-safety evidence manifest; get a deterministic GUARDED / NOT_GUARDED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight guardrail sections (injection defense, tool least privilege, approval gates, sandboxing, budgets and circuit breakers, output validation, secrets hygiene, red teaming) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The agent-safety evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

guardrails_disabled.description: Master guardrail disable flag; must be false.

expect.notes: All 34 checks satisfied. Computed spot checks: 8 sections passed, 0 violations.
